about.title: AFAMIA SKY PLYWOOD LLC
about.p1: AFAMIA SKY PLYWOOD LLC is a plywood factory based in Alexandria, Egypt, operating for two years. Our team has over 15 years of experience in the wood industry and sourcing from the Russian Federation and Europe. We manufacture plywood in a wide range of types and sizes.
about.p2: We supply hardwood, softwood, timber logs and wood veneer, alongside other wood products.
